## 🔄 Integration Architecture

```
PHASE 2A AGENT DEPENDENCIES:

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     ORCHESTRATOR AGENT                       │
│                  (Phase 2A Coordination)                     │
└──────────────┬───────────────────────┬──────────────────────┘
               │                       │
         ┌─────▼─────┐         ┌──────▼────────┐
         │  Testing   │         │ DevOps Agent  │
         │   Agent    │         │  (This Agent) │
         │ (Complete) │         │  (ACTIVATING) │
         └─────┬─────┘         └──────┬────────┘
               │                       │
               └───────────┬───────────┘
                           │
                    ┌──────▼──────┐
                    │   Security  │
                    │    Agent    │
                    └─────────────┘

SEQUENCE:
1. Testing Agent completes → baseline metrics ready
2. DevOps Agent starts → consumes metrics + test suite
3. DevOps Agent creates CI/CD → runs all tests
4. Security Agent validates → security scanning
5. Phase 2A Complete → proceed to Phase 2B
```

  --phase phase-2a-devops-cicd

## 🚨 Failure Scenarios & Recovery

### If Workflow Syntax Validation Fails
```
❌ BLOCKED
Cause: Invalid YAML syntax in workflow files
Recovery:
1. Run: yamllint .github/workflows/
2. Fix identified indentation/syntax issues
3. Revalidate all files
4. Re-run agent with corrected workflows
```

### If Tests Fail in CI
```
❌ BLOCKED
Cause: 3/26 tests failing (88% pass rate)
Recovery:
1. Download test logs from GitHub Actions
2. Identify failing test names and error messages
3. Report to Development Agent for code fixes
4. Rerun workflow after fixes are deployed
```

### If Performance Target Not Met
```
⚠️ WARNING (not blocking)
Cause: Workflow execution time 12 minutes (target: 5-7)
Recovery:
1. Analyze GitHub Actions logs for bottlenecks
2. Increase test parallelization
3. Optimize caching strategy
4. Reduce unnecessary steps
5. Re-run with optimizations
```
